name: VIP Search query offload
description: Adds a Registrable that sends heavy meta and taxonomy queries on one post type to VIP Search (or any ElasticPress backend) through the 'ep_integrate' query var. Adds the queried meta keys to VIP Search's post meta allow list, which indexes none by default, and fires an action whenever an offloaded query silently falls back to MySQL: integration not enabled for the environment, VIP search rate limiting, or an index error. No-ops when no ElasticPress backend is loaded.

wiring.description: Add the class to a Services module so the framework Loader instantiates it and calls register_hooks(). If no suitable module exists, scaffold one first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=Services --kind=registrable`.
